_comment: NSL-KDD attack type -> MITRE ATT&CK technique mapping. Sources: https://attack.mitre.org/

dos._comment: DoS attacks overwhelm target resources. T1498 covers network-level flooding.

neptune._comment: neptune = SYN flood -- sends half-open TCP connections to exhaust server state tables

smurf._comment: smurf = ICMP broadcast amplification reflecting traffic off a third party

pod._comment: pod = Ping of Death, malformed oversized ICMP packet

teardrop._comment: teardrop exploits IP fragment reassembly bugs on the host OS

land._comment: land sends packets with src=dst IP/port to crash/loop the target stack

back._comment: back = Apache back attack -- HTTP requests with too many slashes crash httpd

probe._comment: Probe attacks gather information about hosts/services before an attack

ipsweep._comment: ipsweep scans a range of IP addresses to discover live hosts

portsweep._comment: portsweep scans multiple ports on a host to map open services

nmap._comment: nmap is the canonical network mapping/port scanning tool

satan._comment: satan = Security Administrator Tool for Analyzing Networks, an early vuln scanner

r2l._comment: Remote-to-Local: attacker without account gains local access. T1078/T1190 depending on method.

ftp_write._comment: ftp_write abuses writable anonymous FTP to plant a .rhosts file

guess_passwd._comment: guess_passwd = password guessing / credential brute force over login services

imap._comment: imap exploits buffer overflow in IMAP daemon

multihop._comment: multihop uses intermediate hops to obscure attacker origin

phf._comment: phf = exploit of old CGI script phone directory

warezclient._comment: warezclient uses legitimate credentials to exfiltrate pirated software

httptunnel._comment: httptunnel encapsulates a non-HTTP protocol inside HTTP to evade firewalls

snmpgetattack._comment: snmpgetattack reads device config via weak/guessed SNMP community

xsnoop._comment: xsnoop captures X Window System display to steal credentials/screenshots

u2r._comment: User-to-Root: attacker with local account gains root/admin privileges

buffer_overflow._comment: buffer_overflow exploits stack/heap overflow in a setuid binary

loadmodule._comment: loadmodule uses IFS manipulation to load a trojan module with elevated rights

perl._comment: perl exploits setuid perl scripts to execute with elevated privileges

rootkit._comment: rootkit installs a kernel-level rootkit to hide attacker presence

sqlattack._comment: sqlattack exploits SQL server vulnerabilities to gain elevated DB access
